headline: Actor Christina Applegate reveals she was misdiagnosed with multiple sclerosis
standfirst: Applegate, 54, made the stunning announcement in an episode of her podcast MeSsy, recorded with fellow actor Jamie-Lynn Sigler, posted to YouTube on Tuesday.
body_markdown:
Applegate, 54, made the stunning announcement in an episode of her podcast MeSsy, recorded with fellow actor Jamie-Lynn Sigler, posted to YouTube on Tuesday. (The Guardian Culture)

**South China Morning Post** adds: Christina Applegate, who has candidly shared raw details about her journey with multiple sclerosis for years, revealed on Monday her doctor says she does not have the autoimmune disease and was misdiagnosed. “I’m back at square one where I don’t know what’s going on with me,” the actor said on the latest edition of her podcast “MeSsy”, along with co-host Jamie-Lynn Sigler, who has been public about her own battle with MS.

**BBC Health** adds: Christina Applegate thought she was living with multiple sclerosis (MS) for five years, until recently discovering she had been given a wrong diagnosis.

**Scientific American** adds: The Emmy Award–winning actress revealed that a multiple sclerosis diagnosis in 2021 was incorrect.

**BBC Entertainment & Arts** adds: She said in a Tuesday release of her Messy podcast that she was not happy about the new information and her symptoms have only "gotten worse".

This digest was assembled automatically from reporting by BBC Health, South China Morning Post, Scientific American, BBC Entertainment & Arts and The Guardian Culture. Follow the source links below for the full coverage.
